ValidationRule.description: Stops a Dealer tier being pointed at a Partner level. The ladders share one picklist, so any level would otherwise be selectable on any programme. Pipe delimiters stop CONTAINS matching inside a longer name. Cap here is 255.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Program__c, "")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Next_Tier__c, "")), NOT(CONTAINS( CASE(TEXT(Program__c), "Partner", "|Silver|Gold|Platinum|Diamond|", "Brokerage", "|Registered Rep|Producer|Premier Producer|President's Council|Chairman's Circle|", "Dealer", "|Approved Dealer|Preferred Dealer|Premier Dealer|Elite Dealer|President's Club|", "Commercial Banking", "|Applicant|Onboarding|Treasury Live|", ""), "|" & TEXT(Next_Tier__c) & "|" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: That level does not belong to this programme. Partner: Silver to Diamond. Brokerage: Registered Rep to Chairman's Circle. Dealer: Approved Dealer to President's Club. Commercial Banking: Applicant to Treasury Live.
